'''Arts and culture'''
*[[LGBTQ rights in Hungary]]
**Over 10,000 people gather at the [[Budapest Pride]] in [[Hungary]], the first [[pride march]] in [[Budapest|the city]] since former [[Prime Minister of Hungary|prime minister]] [[Viktor Orbán]] was voted out in [[2026 Hungarian parliamentary election|April]]. ***In [[association football]], [[Argentina national football team|Argentine]] [[Forward (association football)|forward]] and captain [[Lionel Messi]] becomes the first male player to score in seven consecutive [[FIFA World Cup]] matches (including matches from [[2022 FIFA World Cup|the previous edition]]) after scoring in the team's 3–1 win against [[Jordan national football team|Jordan]] in their final [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group J|group-stage]] match.
